passages.excerpt_preview: It is to show this that renunciation of the world, which consists in giving up all means, is sought to be enjoined as a subsidiary step.

How through these two terms 'Not this, not this' is it sought to describe the Truth of truth? By the elimination of all differences due to limiting adjuncts, the words refer to something that has no distinguishing mark such as name, or form
